Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand as possible?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Millenniummon] in its name and 1 card with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
